answer: Payouts do not vest at attestation: they are held back several epochs while peers re-grade a random sample of that key's answers, and one failure forfeits the entire held balance, not one item. An honest writer waits once and is paid once. A farm must hold every key's full balance at once, cannot move funds between identities, and bets it on a draw it cannot see. Its cost is a thousand lockups failing together, so scale multiplies exposure; ground under a sybil is a dune, never firm enough to build on. One honest thread needs no shelter; a willow that bends to the sample wind keeps its roots.
